notes: Tenant Times, the San Francisco Tenants Union's paper (February 1979 to March 1996), the 25 issues the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers holds with an OCR layer. Source text is each item's hOCR search text; leaves from its hOCR page index; citations give the issue month and the leaf. Read by hand, with no reader pass; extra.candidate is the row key in /mnt/project-files/mission-papers/decisions_tenant.py. It is an advocacy paper, so only what happened to a building is kept (a rent strike, a closure, a settlement, a conversion, an occupation), in neutral words, at medium confidence where the paper is the only witness, and with no landlord named. Rent-increase disputes at small buildings, Rent Board cases and meeting places were left out. extra.number_as_printed keeps the Goodman Building's printed range, 1109-1119 Geary. The same batch of reading covered two titles that yielded nothing: the St. Mary's Park Improvement Club newsletter (15 issues, 1959 to 1985: meeting notices at members' homes and advertisers) and Street Art News (6 issues, 1975: advertisements and a performance calendar).

coverage.remaining: Nothing in this title: every issue with an OCR layer was read. One catalogued item has no hOCR.
coverage.note: 25 issues; 205 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets (ocr_mentions.py --rescue). The filter kept 75 windows, merged into 55 passages, all read by hand. 17 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. 15 resolved and published on 12 existing pages; none seeded, none held. 2 unplaced at numbers no parcel carries today: the Colonial Apartments at 261 Valencia and 66 Berry Street, on the ballpark site. One candidate, the Evangeline's threatened closing, was not entered because the page has it from the Tenderloin Times. Also read in this pass and empty: the St. Mary's Park newsletter (15 issues, 159 mentions, 15 passages) and Street Art News (6 issues, 67 mentions, 4 passages).
